digest.component_or_area: store event append / ticket directory creation
propositions: Ticket directory creation races between os.makedirs and first event file write, leaving empty directories when the process is interrupted mid-operation

The old code path creates the ticket directory outside the write lock at line 171 of event_append.py, then only writes the first event file much later under the lock at line 425, creating a vulnerable window

Staging directories with the naming convention .tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex> are excluded from fsck checks by existing dot-prefix conventions, making them invisible to MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH scanners
StagedEvent.promote() publishes directory and first event atomically via os.rename() while still holding the write lock, ensuring event visibility only after rebase guard and under_lock_check pass
The fix must be applied to both single-event stage_and_commit and batch_stage_and_commit paths since both share the vulnerable _prepare_event function
